user.title: Edisio gateway
user.description:
Choose the dongle TYPE then its serial port.

⚠️ The type must match your hardware: “Edisio dongle” (transparent USB adapter) or “GCE RFPlayer”. A wrong choice means the gateway will not work (different protocol and baud rate).

reconfigure.title: Change the dongle / port
reconfigure.description:
Select the dongle type and its serial port. Your configured modules are kept.

⚠️ The type must match your hardware, otherwise the gateway will not work.

discovery_confirm.title: Edisio emitter detected

import_jeedom.title: Import from Jeedom
import_jeedom.description: Upload the `edisio_import.json` file produced beforehand by the `edisio_migrate.py` tool (pick it directly from your computer). Or, if the file is already on the Home Assistant server, give its path instead.

import_confirm.title: Confirm import
import_confirm.description:
Found: {receivers} controllable receiver(s), {emitters} emitter(s), {warnings} warning(s).

Confirm to add these devices. Existing duplicates are skipped.

error.file_not_found: File not found at this path.
error.read_error: Cannot read the file (permissions or path).
error.invalid_format: Invalid import file (JSON expected, produced by the edisio_migrate.py tool).
error.nothing_found: No Edisio devices in this import file.
error.no_input: Upload a file or provide a path.

pair_capture.title: Press the button

configure.title: Configure the device
configure.description: Model: {model}. EDR-B4: for each PAIR of channels choose “2 switches” or “1 cover” (a cover opens on the 1st channel, closes on the 2nd).

add_button.title: Add a button
add_button.description: Give the new button a name (e.g. Centre, Up…).

add_button_capture.description:
Inclusion mode is active.

Press the **{button}** button on the remote, then click **Submit**.
